# book_object_capability (Resource)

The object_capability records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `object_id` (String) Object the capability is assigned to.
- `object_type` (String) Type of the object the capability is assigned to.

### Optional

- `bookable_id` (String) The key of the bookable record.
- `bookable_type_id` (String) The key of the bookable_type record.
- `booking_id` (String) The key of the booking record.
- `capability_id` (String) The key of the capability record.
- `input` (Dynamic) The data filled for the capability on this object.
- `priority` (Number) Resolution priority when multiple capabilities apply.
- `reason` (String) Free form note describing why the capability is assigned.
